decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The roof space, the subject of this proposal, whilst in the same ownership as the maisonette on the ground and lower ground floors, is separated by self contained flats on the first and second floors. The roof space is accessed via a communal staircase. Due to the physical separation ithe roof space cannot be considered as forming part of the planning unit of the ground and lower ground floor maisonette. The development proposed is therefore tantamount to the creation of a new residential unit. Due to the limited size of this unit the accommodation provided is seriously substandard contrary to policy EN1 (Deneral environmental protection and improvement) and HG8 (Increasing the amount of residential accommodation) of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000 and policy H1 (New housing) of the Revised Deposit Draft, as amended by the Proposed Modifications agreed by the Council's Executive on 11th January. It is also contrary to the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidelines 2002 regarding space standards.
Reason : 2 - The proposed roof alterations, by reason of the excessive number of roof lights proposed would be detrimental to the appearance of the building and the character and appearance of the conservation area contrary to policies EN1 (General environmental protection and improvement), EN13 (Design), EN24 (Roof alterations and extensions) and EN31 (Character and appearance of conservation areas) of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000 and the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidelines 2002. Also , policies S1 & S2 (Strategic policies), B1 (General design principles), B3 (Alterations and extensions) and B7 (Conservation areas) of the Revised Deposit Draft as amended by the Proposed Modifications agreed by the Council's Executive on 11th January 2006.
Reason : 3 - The proposed roof accommodation, used as an independent unit and without the provision of adequate off-street parking, would result in an excessive number of flats in the property and would be likely to add to the existing parking stress in the area to the detriment of the local residents. This is contrary to policies TR4 (Cumulative impact of proposals) and TR18 (Parking at residential conversions) of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000 and policies T2 (Capacity of parking provision) and T7 (Off-street parking) of the Revised Deposit Draft, as amended by the Proposed Modifications agreed by the Council's Executive on 11th January 2006.
description: Conversion of attic to provide additional accommodation for a maisonette on the lower and upper ground floor of the building, including installation of 7 conservation roof lights on the rear and side roof slopes and a round window on the  gable of the south elevation.
